digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and datetime/async compliance
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled in global configuration and pass all diagnostics across src/rebar and tests.
All timezone-aware datetime operations must use explicit datetime.timezone.utc; timezone-less persisted strings must be assigned UTC before clustering, and literal datetime.UTC token is prohibited.
Epoch timestamp conversion to UTC cluster keys must produce identical results across distinct process TZ settings on POSIX/macOS platforms via time.tzset().
Security-pin cadence staleness checks must obtain an aware current instant with explicit timezone, convert to host timezone, and extract host-local calendar date for comparison.
Six pre-existing ASYNC/DTZ diagnostics across validate_checks.py, security_pin.py, test_jira_onboard.py, and test_review_bot.py must be resolved before rule selection.
